name: Default Class
description: Adds informative CSS classes (region, node, user, term, block-content type) to rendered markup.
project_description:
* Adds region machine names as classes on blocks.

* Adds a class on any node with one individual piece of content.

* Adds a class on any user with one individual piece of content.

* Adds a class on any term with one individual piece of content.

 INSTALLATION 

 - Install via /admin/modules

- drush en default_class -y

- composer require drupal/default_class
